title: Plan Change Timing on Loop+ Membership
content:
Desk card: the timing settings that apply when a Loop+ Membership moves from one plan to another, by the plan the member is moving from.

| Plan the member is moving from | When a move from a monthly to an annual plan takes effect | Credit for the unused part of the monthly fee when switching to annual | When a move from an annual plan to another plan takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | immediate | unused calendar days of the current cycle | not applicable |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | immediate | unused calendar days of the current cycle | not applicable |
| Loop+ Student Annual | not applicable | not applicable | end of the term |
| Loop+ Monthly | immediate | unused calendar days of the current cycle | not applicable |
| Loop+ Annual | not applicable | not applicable | end of the term |
| Loop+ Household Annual | not applicable | not applicable | end of the term |

**Switch to annual effective**: when a move from a monthly to an annual plan takes effect; not applicable on annual plans. Each monthly plan carries immediate.

**Switch to annual credit basis**: the credit given for the unused part of the monthly fee when switching to annual; not applicable on annual plans. Each monthly plan carries the unused calendar days of the current cycle.

**Switch from annual effective**: when a move from an annual plan to another plan takes effect; not applicable on monthly plans. Each annual plan carries the end of the term.

Reading the card:

- A member on Loop+ Monthly, Loop+ Student Monthly or Loop+ Access Monthly who moves to an annual plan moves immediately, and the credit is sized on the unused calendar days of the current monthly cycle.
- A member on Loop+ Student Annual, Loop+ Annual or Loop+ Household Annual who moves to another plan moves at the end of the term.
